source.compiler: SI's own data files from the retail CD's InstallShield cabinet (DATA1.CAB), read by HTTP range from archive.org championship-manager-season-9900 (CM9900_REL.bin), each file's MD5 as the cabinet header records it
source.provenance: The CD's volume CM9900_REL was mastered on 16 November 1999; the game was released on 3 December 1999. A second copy, the Dutch CD (archive.org cm-9900-nl), carries a byte-identical cabinet header, so every data file's MD5 agrees. The squads are of the autumn of 1999: Vieri at Inter, Anelka at Real Madrid, Shevchenko at Milan; Bradford City, Watford and Sunderland promoted. It names the Eredivisie after its sponsor (Dutch KPN-Telecompetition) and spells Burkina Faso 'Burkino Faso'; both are read as such. For players matched by name and date of birth, 70.5% of current abilities equal the CM3 port's (1998/99), which sit 2.0 lower on average (15,637 players, correlation 0.947): the scale of the seasons around it, so the conversion is CM 01/02's, unchanged.
